title: Hearth of Stone
shortDescription: Granite takes the weight and does not complain.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Stone is a vaulted room that feels older than the hall that leads to it. Granite blocks fit as if they had chosen one another. Dust hangs in cool light. A carved keystone watches the door.
Mentor Quern stands like another block that learned to speak.

fixtures.name: Mentor Quern
fixtures.lookDescription: A massive grey badger with granite-dusted paws and a mason's belt. Try talk quern.
fixtures.examineDescription: Quern's stripe is pale with stone-dust. The belt is heavy. He does not hurry a sentence, and he does not drop one.
fixtures.dialogue: "Stone holds. Look this hearth. Find Flint. Come back."

welcome.text: "I am Quern. Stone teaches you to hold. Look this hearth. Walk to the South Orchard. Attack the dummy once. Return and talk to me."

craft.text: "A wall that boasts is already failing. First you look at what is already holding. Then you strike a thing that is meant to be struck. Then you come back."

go.text: "Look the keystone. Then find the orchard. I will be here."

lessons-done.text: "You have looked. You have stood in the orchard. Stone has your name, and your kit is open. Alder waits in the High Study with a question about the bell below."

fixtures.name: Carved Keystone
fixtures.examineDescription: The keystone is plain except for a shallow mark like a held breath. The blocks around it have not shifted. A slate says: 'Carry the weight you named.'
